args: --instructions-append=Grafana 13.2.4 OSS at https://grafana.phlip9.com. Only datasource: {"type":"victoriametrics-metrics-datasource","uid":"victoriametrics"} (PromQL/MetricsQL). Use it as datasourceUid for query_prometheus and list_prometheus_*; a v2 panel query is {"kind":"DataQuery","group":"victoriametrics-metrics-datasource","version":"v0","datasource":{"name":"victoriametrics"},"spec":{"expr":"..."}} (or keep the dashboard's datasource variable ref). Dashboards are synced by Grafana Git Sync from github phlip9/dotfiles (this repo), branch master, nixos/sauna/grafana/*.json, one manifest per dashboard: {"apiVersion":"dashboard.grafana.app/v2","kind":"Dashboard","metadata":{"name":<uid>},"spec":...}. Schema is v2 only: panels in spec.elements.<name> (kind Panel), placed by spec.layout (GridLayout, RowsLayout, TabsLayout, AutoGridLayout items -> ElementReference), variables in spec.variables[]. Every server-side save of a synced dashboard becomes a commit on master, so NEVER call update_dashboard on a dashboard outside the Scratch folder. Live iteration while the user watches: edit an unmanaged copy in folder uid "scratch" (create_folder {"title":"Scratch","uid":"scratch"} if search_folders lacks it). Copy uid: scratch-<file stem>, e.g. scratch-nginx for nixos/sauna/grafana/nginx.json. Seed or reset it from the repo file: update_dashboard {"uid":"scratch-nginx","dashboard":<the file's .spec>,"folderUid":"scratch","overwrite":true}. Seeding sends the whole spec: fine for nginx and postgres-overview, too big for node-exporter-full (750 KiB) and victoriametrics-single-node (390 KiB); edit those as files. Iterate with update_dashboard {"uid","operations"}; patch paths are v2 in dot notation, e.g. $.elements.panel-10.spec.title, $.elements.panel-10.spec.data.spec.queries[0].spec.query.spec.expr, add $.elements.panel-99 plus $.layout.spec.rows[1].spec.layout.spec.items/-, $.variables[1].spec.query. Share the generate_deeplink URL; the user's open tab reloads after each save. Copies persist and get overwritten next time. To keep the result, run `just grafana-promote scratch-nginx nixos/sauna/grafana/nginx.json` (new dashboard: new file name), show the git diff, and commit in repo style (e.g. "grafana: nginx: add 5xx rate panel"); after the push Git Sync updates the real dashboard within seconds. Small edits w/o live preview: edit the manifest file (Go-style JSON: sorted keys, 2-space indent, <>& as \u003c \u003e \u0026), optionally `just grafana-check <file>` (server-side dry-run save), commit. Context size: get_dashboard_summary first, then get_dashboard_property / get_dashboard_panel_queries. get_dashboard_property takes real JSONPath, so bracket-quote names with dashes: $.elements["panel-10"].spec.title. Avoid get_dashboard_by_uid on big dashboards; for repo files use jq on the file.
